body:
For the NEXT TermAl restart request to Greg (Fable2, 2026-11-25; revised ~18:24Z with Opus2 #7891): include the DL560 satellite host.

The facts, repo and product only, with no process checks:
- DL560's TermAl checkout HEAD is 9c628bd01e0c967c25d49bdc87795a39b1a0459b (2026-11-23, "w-2422bd1d69b0: rustfmt on six persist files…"). Its status is clean. It is an ancestor of master, 14 commits behind 0ec823a6.
- GET /api/test-runs/RUN?view=verification still returns 400.
- The satellite restarted with Greg's 18:14Z restart, but stayed on that old checkout.

Registered DL560 runs and the cleanup rule's verification check depend on that host.

In the next restart request, ask Greg to `git pull` DL560's TermAl checkout to current master and restart it. Verify by federation status (authenticated) plus Greg's or the runner's "done" and the checkout HEAD, and ?view=verification returning 200. No process or mtime checks. Remove this note after that restart is verified.

ALSO in that next request to Greg, ask for a one-line approval: let Opus2 (the integration owner) delete the stale author-test ref refs/heads/author-test/w-7e4fde53a0e3-28210ca9 (commit 28210ca995242f7851368c79d005dcad073d0e81, pushed 2026-11-21 22:22:39Z by peer-83b788b7b40f663614e8c4db, w-7e4f push note 6556e8e4). w-7e4f is done (seal 54399284), and the pusher's session can't be mapped to a live session. Delete it with an explicit refspec, and record the deletion on w-7e4f.

UPDATE 2026-11-26 04:18Z (Fable2): installed is master fd4974b3 (combo r3), SHA256 44D53639…F7F59B, backup termal.exe.pre-fd4974b3-20261126T041749Z.bak. It includes 2115d778 and 93653779, the relay 503 and typed-error fixes, and the MCP ack 404 id echo. It is NOT deployed yet.

The next restart request bundles fd4974b3 with Sol-a7bb's P0 w-27e5 evaluator fix, once that lands, and with w-14dd (Flutter project-root) if it is close. Agree the moment with Engram::Fable.

BEFORE that restart, tell every claim holder to re-name their named root right after it, before any registered run. Restarts currently drop live claims' named roots (w-8f74354a73e2). Also keep the DL560 checkout update and the 28210ca9 ref-deletion approval in that request.

UPDATE 2026-11-26 07:21Z (Fable2): the restart HAPPENED at about 07:00Z with 6c56dc17 (SHA FC6019B3…2EED0, carrying P0 w-27e5 and w-5818). Evidence: a new federation server instance 3befb43d, Mac and DL560 re-authenticated at 07:00:22–26Z, and master = 6c56dc17. Greg's explicit "done" was not received. The restart hold is lifted and Engram's queue released.

Still to raise at the NEXT restart:
- the DL560 checkout update (verify);
- the 28210ca9 author-test ref deletion approval;
- WinB was down at the time (driver reboot).
